children: said on Sunday its first-half loss widened to 2.2 billion yuan ($327.09 million) from a loss of 1.4 billion yuan a year earlier, according to a filing with the Shanghai Stock Exchange.
Revenue in the first six months of 2026 rose 11.1% from a year earlier to 74.2 billion yuan, the filing said.
